motion.name: eink
motion.purpose: E-ink and reduced-motion behavior via AppMotion.

components.name: E-ink elevated button
components.description: Explicit e-ink elevated-button appearance. Browser focus remains available.
components.css: .ds-eink-button { background: #000; color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 24px; min-height: 50px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: E-ink outlined button
components.description: Explicit e-ink outlined-button appearance. Flutter owns actual interactive states.
components.css: .ds-eink-outlined { background: #fff; color: #000; border: 2px solid #000; border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 24px; min-height: 50px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: E-ink field
components.description: E-ink fill, label, border and focus thickness from InputDecorationTheme.
components.css: .ds-eink-field-label { color: #000; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-eink-field { display: block; background: #f5f5f5; color: #000; border: 2px solid #000; border-radius: 0; padding: 16px; } .ds-eink-field::placeholder { color: #404040; } .ds-eink-field:focus { border-width: 4px; outline: none; }

components.name: E-ink selected chip
components.description: Color and border swatch only. Shape and padding are inherited from Flutter.
components.css: .ds-eink-chip { display: inline-block; background: #c0c0c0; color: #000; border: 2px solid #000; }

components.name: E-ink card
components.description: E-ink shared card shape and margin. Content padding belongs to callers.
components.css: .ds-eink-card { background: #fff; color: #000; border: 2px solid #000; border-radius: 0; margin: 8px; }

components.name: E-ink navigation
components.description: Bottom-navigation label color and weight swatch. Layout remains platform-owned.
components.css: .ds-eink-nav { background: #fff; color: #404040; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-eink-nav-selected { color: #000; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview: Papyrus uses its existing Material 3 theme for a readable, adaptive library and reader. Muted violet accents sit on neutral surfaces, with separate light, dark, high-contrast and e-ink themes. This record describes the implemented system, without introducing a new visual identity.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic theme colors and text roles.
dos: Do resolve colors and typography through the active Flutter theme.
Do preserve text scaling, accessibility typography and reduced-motion settings.
Do use existing spacing and radius tokens for shared components.
donts: Don't hard-code the light palette into adaptive widgets.
Don't carry standard-theme elevation and animation into e-ink components.
